review: The saviour of Charge society, some proclaim. LCE E.G.O::AEDD Gregor, shortened to AEDD Gregor for the sake of this review, is a pure Charge support ID who focuses on giving allies Charge Count through his passive/status. The next few paragraphs will break down his entire kit one by one! Firstly, he has a total of 4 unique statuses. - High-voltage Exoskeleton acts as a better Charge barrier (by a small margin), giving Shield and converting it to Charge Count at the end of the turn based on stack. - Self-charge gives him final power and acts as a last-ditch effort to do something before dying. As long as he has this status, he will not drop below 1 HP. There are multiple ways to decrease/remove this status, such as attack end of skills that hit this unit, attack end, and turn end.
